name: argument-integrity-real-datastore
claim_boundary: This harness verifies the real EvidenceClaimService.add_critique path against disposable Neo4j and PostgreSQL instances under the exercised two-contender schedules. It does not prove every possible scheduler interleaving or a production deployment migration.

inform: Bind every observation to the locked ARG-1 through ARG-5 requirement ids.
Bind the receipt to hashes of the requirement spec, test harness, fixture, and service source.
constrain: Use only testcontainers-owned Neo4j and PostgreSQL instances; production datastore environment values are not consumed.
Require five named tests, no skips, bounded barriers, bounded subprocess time, and a blocking CI job.
verify: Call the real service through AppContainer.kg and AppContainer.hist.
Use independent Cypher and SQL readback for argument, relationship, claim-token, lock, and history cardinality.
Exercise same-node and cross-node two-session races.
correct: Run the identical harness against the historical pre-fix revision and require semantic assertion failures rather than import or infrastructure errors.
Run the current source again after the negative control and require restored GREEN.
